news.headline: Chicago beats the Saints 21-13
news.summary: Chicago sacked Tyler Shough six times, once for a safety, and the Saints scored one touchdown, a one-yard catch by Alvin Kamara. New Orleans has now won three games and lost seven.

news.headline: Tyler Shough practices without the glove on his hand
news.summary: The Saints quarterback has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, and this week he practiced without the glove he had been wearing over it. The team has not said the hand is healed.

news.headline: Jordan Howden takes over at safety
news.summary: Justin Reid asked the Saints to let him go on Thursday after starting the first nine games. Jordan Howden, who is in his fourth year with the team, starts next to Julian Blackmon on Sunday.

news.headline: Florida beats Vanderbilt 34-27 on senior day
news.summary: Florida trailed 24-17 at halftime and came back to win its last home game. Jadan Baugh scored the go-ahead touchdown with 2:19 left, and Eric Singleton caught passes for 117 yards, the most of his career.

news.headline: Sumrall says the Gators won in spite of themselves

news.headline: Sumrall did not like Tuesday's practice
news.summary: Florida's coach stopped a slow practice and made the team run six plays of full-contact goal line work. He said the Gators have not handled winning well this year.
